Team —

QBR is three weeks out; this thread is to consolidate a tight deliverable set for Sales Leadership and Ops. Goal: we produce a one-page account dossier per named mid-to-large deal and a single consolidated forecast table for the deck. High level asks: 

1) Rishi: can you produce account-by-account summaries for the 10 committed+best-opps (2 paragraphs each) with top risks and recommended next-step (who owns next-step). Include ARR math and expected close month. Put these in the attached ledger format.

2) Marissa: please review the dossiers for OKR alignment (Growth / Strategic accounts / ARR churn risk) and flag ones that need leader-level engagement.

3) Laura: I’ll need the org ask/decision sheet by EOD Monday so we can include any escalation items in the leadership prep.

Deliverables and timeline: 
- Rishi: initial dossier + ledger (spreadsheet) by Fri 04/02 COB.
- Marissa: annotation and OKR flags by Mon 04/05 noon PT.
- Jordan (me): consolidate notes and produce single forecast slide by Mon 04/05 4pm PT.

Attachments: I started a native ledger (QBR_account_ledger.xlsx) — please use tabs for committed, best_opps, and watchlist. Keep each dossier to 150–200 words.

Keep it tight — we will iterate once consolidated.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, North America Sales
Redwood Inference

Jordan —

Attached is the first pass (see QBR_account_ledger.xlsx, tab 'committed' + 'best_opps'). I focused on the 10 deals we called out in last week’s forecast sync. Highlights below for the ones I think will move into commit this quarter: 

1) Cardinal Health (Oliver Grant) — $420k ARR potential, expected close May. Risk: procurement delay; mitigation: expedited SOC2 evidence and a 30-day pilot with restricted dataset. Owner: Oliver -> Rishi (next-step: procurement call 4/9).

2) EdgePlatform (michael.sales@edgeplatform.io) — $150k ARR, May/June close, risk: integration timeline with their on-prem deployment. Suggest a technical deep-dive with infra PM. Owner: Rishi.

3) FinTechCo (Kate Lin) — $600k ARR (strategic), expected commit June. Risk: privacy/legal redlines on data residency. Escalation: loop in Private deployment team and schedule legal to review SOW. Owner: Kate / Marissa to coordinate.

I added short bullets under 'Top risks' and 'Next step' for each account and a probability % based on recent buyer signals (calls, procurement calendar, legal RFP). Spreadsheet also has a simple consolidated row showing pipeline at each confidence band (30/60/90) by month.

Notes: some deals still need a refreshed quote with quantized model profiles; I flagged those in column 'quote_needed'.

If you want, I can extract the 150–200 word dossier text into a separate doc for direct slide paste.

—Rishi
